long_biography.plain_text:
Kolenda spent a decade overseeing sales and distribution at Aussie Home Loans before founding mortgage originator X Inc. That company later merged with Ray White's mortgage-broking operation, where he became an executive director. In 2011 he co-founded Finsure, developing a technology-enabled aggregation business that connected brokers with lenders and supplied compliance, commission and loan-processing infrastructure.

Finsure's acquisition placed Kolenda on the board and executive team of the listed buyer, with shares issued for his holding. The business changed hands again in 2022, when MA Financial acquired it and appointed him to lending strategy and growth. He has also chaired and held a major interest in Aura Group. His identifiable wealth mechanism combines founder equity, executive earnings and business transactions; enterprise purchase prices, managed loan books and assets under management are not personal assets.
